newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Somague, Silva e Silva discuss share swap.
newsitem.headline: Somague, Silva e Silva discuss share swap.

text.p: Portuguese construction group Somague and A.Silva e Silva have held conversations about a possible exchange of shares, a statement from both companies said.
One option would be for Somague to acquire some or all of the construction interests of A.Silva e Silva, it said.

"A.Silva e Silva and Somague have held conversations to discuss a future relationship involving an exchange of shares and/or the total or partial acquisition by Somague of the construction interests of A.Silva e Silva," it said.
"The two groups hope to be able to announce the conclusions of these conversations soon," it added.
The Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) today suspended trade in both shares.
